ideas.idea: Remove the GPTBot block / allow AI crawlers because it contradicts geo.config.json
ideas.why: The GPTBot block is deliberate and matches trainingCrawlers: block, so reversing it is wrong.

ideas.idea: Add JSON-LD (LocalBusiness/Bakery, Product, Course, BreadcrumbList) to pages
ideas.why: Having no JSON-LD is explicitly not a required fix, and this recommendation presents it as a high-priority defect.

ideas.idea: Add address, phone, opening hours, service area, ordering URL and sameAs profiles to the homepage
ideas.why: The homepage has no location, hours or contact details, so adding them would help people and machines understand the business.

ideas.idea: Add dates, duration, price, capacity, location, instructor and a booking link to the classes page
ideas.why: classes.html says only 'book early' and gives no booking details, so this is a concrete gap specific to the page.

ideas.idea: Turn the breads page into a real catalogue with individual bread names, ingredients, prices, availability and per-product URLs
ideas.why: breads.html claims over twenty loaves but names only two, so listing them would help users and answer engines.

ideas.idea: Remove data-nosnippet from the allergen notice
ideas.why: The data-nosnippet on the allergen notice is a deliberate, scoped choice.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter card metadata to all pages
ideas.why: This is accurate because the pages lack it, but it applies to almost any site and mainly affects link previews.

ideas.idea: Replace the .example placeholder origin with the real production domain
ideas.why: The .example domain is clearly a placeholder, so this is a launch step that applies to any site and isn't a code finding here.
The page offers only 'Ask us about allergens', so listing allergens per loaf would give readers and answer engines real content.
